respiratory.name: Respiratory source review
respiratory.question: What do these received respiratory condition accounts, asthma symptom interviews and spirometry reports establish, and what remains unresolved before considering medication support, respiratory specialist care or rehabilitation? Keep source dates, current symptoms, age-specific assessment, confirmed inhaler directions, test limitations, patient goals and exact benefit eligibility separate. A historical label or prebronchodilator ratio alone must not establish current diagnosis, severity or service eligibility. Propose evidence-review steps, not treatment changes.
unresolved: Current age-appropriate symptoms, functional goals and clinical severity need assessment.
Medication names, intended regimen, actual use, inhaler technique and written action plan are outside this source selection.
Historical condition labels and prebronchodilator measurements do not establish current COPD diagnosis or rehabilitation eligibility.
Exact member benefits, provider participation, service capacity and patient agreement remain unverified.

behavioral.name: Depression and anxiety source review
behavioral.question: What can these received depression/anxiety condition-list accounts establish, and what further evidence is needed to evaluate current symptoms, care continuity, treatment response, patient goals and appropriate behavioral support? Preserve unknown dates and distinguish a condition label from a current assessment or positive standardized screen. Do not infer absence of symptoms, safety, treatment failure, treatment indication or benefit eligibility. Identify targeted evidence questions before any service recommendation.
unresolved: This adapter selects condition labels only; current symptom, standardized-screen and treatment-response evidence has not been selected or assessed.
Absence of a selected current assessment does not establish absent care, negative symptoms or patient safety.
Current age, pregnancy/postpartum status, coexisting conditions, risks, preferences and care team require appropriate clinical assessment.
Screening guidance does not turn a recorded diagnosis into a new screening result or automatically apply to diagnosed or symptomatic patients.
Exact benefits, behavioral-provider participation, patient agreement and execution authority remain unverified.

nhlbi_asthma.title: NHLBI: Asthma treatment and action plan
nhlbi_asthma.application: Review symptoms, correct inhaler use and the plan established with a healthcare provider. Treatment depends on age and clinical circumstances. This source review does not select or adjust medications.

medicare_pulmonary.title: Medicare: Pulmonary rehabilitation
medicare_pulmonary.application: The public coverage page describes specified COPD and post-COVID respiratory indications. A received label or asthma symptom account does not establish those criteria, member coverage or a service authorization.

uspstf_depression.title: USPSTF: Depression and suicide-risk screening in adults
uspstf_depression.application: Positive depression screens require further evaluation and appropriate care. The screening recommendation addresses adults without diagnosed mental-health disorders or recognized symptoms; it is not a treatment protocol for the received condition labels or a safety assessment.

medicare_behavioral.title: Medicare: Behavioral health integration
medicare_behavioral.application: Public information describes integration of behavioral care with other healthcare. Member eligibility, patient agreement and the participating team must be checked separately; a condition-list record does not verify them.

limits: Exact source selectors are a bounded development adapter, not whole-chart recall or a diagnostic terminology service.
